high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from U.S. Ambassador Eric Garcetti. The tweet commemorates the 16th anniversary of the 26/11 terror attacks in Mumbai. The text reads: "Today marks the 16th anniversary of the 26/11 terror attacks in Mumbai. We honor the memory of the victims lost and pledge to continue the fight against acts of terror together with the Government of India." Below the text, there is an image showing a man kneeling in front of a memorial. The man is dressed in a dark suit and appears to be placing or adjusting something on the memorial
